go-jsonschema generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Schema

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": ["object", "boolean"],
  "additionalProperties": {"type": "string"}
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/schemapkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

func TestSchema_RoundTripBool(t *testing.T) {
	var s Schema
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`true`), &s); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if got, ok := s.TypeBoolean(); !ok || got != true {
		t.Errorf("TypeBoolean = (%v, %v), want (true, true)", got, ok)
	}
}

func TestSchema_RoundTripObject(t *testing.T) {
	var s Schema
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"a":"hello"}`), &s); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	got, ok := s.TypeObject()
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("TypeObject ok = false, want true")
	}
	if got["a"] != "hello" {
		t.Errorf("got[a] = %q, want %q", got["a"], "hello")
	}
}
